experiment.title: MMB Baseline Reproduction
experiment.objective: Reproduce the current MMB baseline on VISO ship with fixed seeds, locked preprocessing, and a single benchmark protocol before testing any new hypothesis.

notes: Always start with devsample before any full-dataset run on VISO.
Use devsample for smoke checks and VISO for reported baseline runs.
Do not change preprocessing, augmentation, or split definitions during reproduction.

phases.name: smoke_validation
phases.purpose: Verify scaffold and devsample layout before touching full data.

phases.name: smoke_manifest_generation
phases.purpose: Freeze run manifests for deterministic smoke-test seeds.

phases.name: full_validation
phases.purpose: Verify full dataset availability before benchmark runs.

phases.name: full_manifest_generation
phases.purpose: Freeze the five reported baseline runs.

notes: Run the full classical MMB stack (AMFD + LRMC + PF) instead of proxy mode.
Keep AMFD/PF defaults aligned to paper guidance (k=4, trajectory window=5, 7x7 association gate).
Use paper component filtering bounds for AMFD/LRMC proposals.
